Product Details: The DongCheng DCJZ2060 20V Cordless Drill is built for precision and designed for performance, making it an ideal companion for both professionals and DIY enthusiasts. Powered by a high-efficiency brushless motor, this drill delivers strong, consistent power and a longer operational life. With 20+2 torque settings, you can fine-tune control for a wide range of materials and applications, from delicate furniture assembly to heavy-duty construction work. The 2-speed gearbox offers 0–600/min for low-speed tasks and 0–2300/min for high-speed drilling, while the maximum torque of 60N.m ensures effortless performance on wood, metal, brick walls, and concrete. The 13mm keyless chuck allows for quick and easy bit changes, and the integrated LED work light illuminates dark working areas for improved visibility. At just 1.5kg with battery, the ultra-compact, ergonomic body is easy to carry and comfortable to hold during extended use. The 20V MAX 2.0Ah Li-ion battery provides longer runtime with no memory effect and supports faster charging. The package includes the cordless drill, 2 x 20V Li-ion batteries, 1 x charger, 1 x belt clip, 1 x carrying case, and 1 x user manual.
